title: Slow Mining
description: A fully customizable datapack that reduces mining speed, making progression slower and more realistic.
body:
# Slow Mining

[![Download on Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Modrinth-1bd96a?style=for-the-badge\&logo=modrinth\&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/slow-mining)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join-Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/xS85W48Cb3)

## Overview

This datapack **reduces the mining speed** of players by **75%** (*minecraft:block_break_speed = 0.25*).

**Slow Mining** makes the **early game** and **late game** of a world or server **more challenging and fun**.

## Configuration

To configure how fast players break blocks, unzip the datapack, open the folder, and navigate to:

**`data/slowmining/function/tick.mcfunction`**

Open the file and edit the value on the **2nd line** of code to customize the mining speed.

## ⚠️ IMPORTANT

If you want to **disable or remove** the datapack, run:

**`/function slowmining:disable`**,

otherwise the datapack **will not disable properly**.

## Help

Run **`/function slowmining:help`** for help, or join our **[Discord](https://discord.gg/xS85W48Cb3)**:
